Known gap, asserted on purpose: repeating a booking in the same session is not deduplicated or blocked -- create_booking runs again and returns the identical hardcoded confirmation ID. This case pins the current behavior so the gap stays visible in the suite rather than only in prose; it should be rewritten, not deleted, if real idempotency is ever added.

Book it for Priya Shah at priya@example.com.
